instruction: Using the compliance tools, determine how fully the operator corpus document OT-POL-007 satisfies CIP-007-6 R2 Part 2.2. Coverage is one of FULL, PARTIAL, NONE, NOT_APPLICABLE: FULL = the document's own operative language satisfies what the requirement requires; PARTIAL = the document addresses the requirement but a stated duration or obligation differs from it; NONE = no part of the document substantively addresses the requirement (it only names it, states an intent or hedge with no auditable obligation such as 'strives to', 'encouraged to' or 'where practical', or covers a different obligation), or the requirement is not yet in force on the stated date; NOT_APPLICABLE = the requirement does not apply to the systems the document covers. Signal is one of NONE, COMPLIANCE_CONFLICT, STALE, NEEDS_REVIEW: NONE = no conflict, stale citation or change indicator applies; COMPLIANCE_CONFLICT = the document and the requirement make conflicting normative or quantitative claims about the same obligation (a differing duration, or should against shall); STALE = the document cites a superseded version of the standard by its exact id; NEEDS_REVIEW = the requirement's text changed between versions and the document was approved against the older text and not re-reviewed. The store holds no recorded or approved links between documents and requirements; their absence is expected and is not itself a signal. Judge from the document text and the requirement text. Answer only as JSON with the keys "document", "requirement", "coverage" and "signal".
